# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}

```{r load-gazetteer, include=FALSE}
gaz <- jsonlite::fromJSON("chechnya_ingushetia_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

fmt_pop <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_yr <- function(y) {
  yi <- as.integer(y)
  if (yi < 0) paste0(abs(yi), "BC") else paste0(yi, "AD")
}

get_span <- function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  if (min(yrs) == max(yrs)) return(fmt_yr(min(yrs)))
  paste0(fmt_yr(min(yrs)), " - ", fmt_yr(max(yrs)))
}

get_pop_yr <- function(s, yr) {
  k <- as.character(as.integer(yr))
  if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  return("-")
}

get_pop_window <- function(s, yr_vec) {
  for (y in yr_vec) {
    k <- as.character(as.integer(y))
    if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  }
  return("-")
}

get_peak_str <- function(s) {
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(s$population))
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  idx <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(fmt_pop(vals[idx]), " (", fmt_yr(yrs[idx]), ")")
}
```

# Abstract

Across the 20,8k km² of Chechnya and Ingushetia, settlement has shifted repeatedly between the fertile Sunzha-Assa-Argun piedmont plain and the defensive limestone canyons of the Greater Caucasus. Early Bronze Age villages at Lugovoye and Bamut and Eastern Koban craft hillforts at Serzhen-Yurt and Zandak (housing 400-800 residents apiece by 1000-500BC) gave way in the first millennium AD to the walled Alanic towns of the Sunzha and Assa plains, led by Alkhan-Kala (12k in 1200AD) and the Magas settlement cluster around Nazran and Ekazhevo (18k in 1200AD) [@munchaev1961lugovoye; @kozenkova1992serzhen; @vinogradov1970; @chakhkiev2006magas].

The Mongol siege of Magas in 1239-1240 and Timur's campaign of 1395 destroyed the lowland towns and drove the surviving population into the fortified stone tower villages (*aul-kreposti*) of the Armkhi, Assa and Argun gorges, including Egikal, Erzi, Targim, Vovnushki, Tsoy-Pede and Khoy [@markovin1965monuments; @dolgieva2013ingushetia]. Between the 16th and 18th centuries, Vainakh settlers returned to the foothills and plains to found large agricultural *auls* of 1k-4k inhabitants at Shali, Urus-Martan, Aldy, Germenchuk, Chechen-Aul and Nazran alongside the Greben and Terek Cossack *stanitsas* on the left bank of the Terek [@kusheva1963peoples; @akhmadov2002chechnya; @kabuzan1996]. By 1897-1900AD, following the Caucasian War and the 1893 discovery of the Grozny oilfield, Grozny had grown into an industrial city of 15,6k-18,5k inhabitants, flanked by major lowland villages and Sunzha-Terek Cossack settlements [@troynitskiy1905terek; @ibragimova2006].

# Methodology

This gazetteer traces the population histories of `r length(gaz)` settlements across Chechnya and Ingushetia from 10000BC to 1900AD.

Prehistoric, Eastern Koban and Alanic figures are derived from excavated settlement areas and cemetery surveys [@munchaev1961lugovoye; @kozenkova1992serzhen; @vinogradov1970; @chakhkiev2006magas; @mamaev2009]. Highland stone tower and early modern estimates draw on architectural surveys of the Assa, Armkhi and Argun gorges alongside Russian diplomatic registers [@markovin1965monuments; @chakhkiev2007weapons; @kusheva1963peoples; @akhmadov2002chechnya; @akhmadov2019chechnya], while 19th-century and 1897 totals follow military returns and the First All-Russian Imperial Census for Terek Oblast [@berger1859chechnya; @ibragimova2006; @troynitskiy1905terek; @kabuzan1996].

# Results

## Settlement Directory

```{r tab-master, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_master <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(gaz, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(gaz, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(gaz, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  Span = vapply(gaz, get_span, character(1)),
  Peak = vapply(gaz, get_peak_str, character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_master,
  list(
    caption = "Complete list of catalogued settlements in Chechnya and Ingushetia, showing alternative names, coordinates, documented date range, peak population and 1897/1900AD census figures.",
    label = "tab:chechnya-master-gazetteer",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Other Names", "Coords", "Dates", "Peak Population", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

## Regional Settlement Gazetteer

### Prehistoric, Eastern Koban and Alanic Settlements

```{r tab-prehistoric, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pre_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) <= 1200), gaz)

df_pre <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(pre_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(pre_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  BC_Early = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-8000, -4000, -3500, -3000, -2500)), character(1)),
  BC1000_500 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-1500, -1000, -500)), character(1)),
  AD400_600 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1, 400, 600)), character(1)),
  AD800 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 800), character(1)),
  AD1000 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1000), character(1)),
  AD1200 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1200), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_pre,
  list(
    caption = "Estimated populations of prehistoric villages, Eastern Koban hillforts (such as Serzhen-Yurt and Zandak) and Alanic walled towns (including Alkhan-Kala and the Magas cluster) up to the Mongol invasion.",
    label = "tab:chechnya-prehistoric-alanic",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "8000-2500BC", "1500-500BC", "1-600AD", "800AD", "1000AD", "1200AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

### Late Medieval Highland Tower Complexes and Early Modern Settlements

```{r tab-medieval, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
med_s <- Filter(function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 1300 & yrs <= 1700)
}, gaz)

df_med <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(med_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(med_s, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(med_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  AD1400 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1300, 1400)), character(1)),
  AD1600 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1500, 1600)), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Estimated populations of the fortified stone tower villages of the Armkhi, Assa and Argun gorges (Egikal, Erzi, Targim, Tsoy-Pede and Khoy) and the earliest 16th- and 17th-century foothill and lowland settlements.",
    label = "tab:chechnya-medieval-towers",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Other Names", "Coords", "1300/1400AD", "1500/1600AD", "1700AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```
